title: Point-cloud reconstruction operation record (v1)
description: Contract for operation `pointcloud_reconstruction` (registry stage 3, NOT_IMPLEMENTED). Added in the Stage 3 planning correction: camera frames and camera trajectories are not point clouds — this is the only operation that generates genuine 3D geometry from capture. Stage 3.0 finalization: two declared paths — opencv_assisted (requires a TRJ- trajectory) and colmap_native (poses estimated inside COLMAP; trajectory_id may be null). No artificial points may be produced to fake success; failed reconstruction produces a failed record, never placeholder geometry.

trajectory_id.description: Mandatory for the OpenCV-assisted path; may be null on the COLMAP-native path, where pose provenance is the recorded COLMAP tool/version.

pipeline_path.description: Which declared reconstruction path produced this output (see the registry `paths`).

settings.description: Processing settings actually used. Quality-reducing adjustments (frame rate limits, point limits) must be recorded here, never applied silently.

scale_status.description: Positions are in reconstruction units until a metric basis is fused in with provenance.

message.description: Human-readable result or failure reason. Never fabricated measurements.

scale-provenance.description: Rules: UNKNOWN pairs with basis 'none'; operator_assumed stays ESTIMATED at best; VALIDATED requires independent metric evidence.
